tool.name: LAMMPS (Frontier)

param.name: xyz
param.label: .xyz file
param.help: The coordinate file. It is made available to LAMMPS under the name it has in your history, so that name must match what the .lmp file reads.

param.name: extra_files
param.label: Additional input files
param.help: Any other files the .lmp script reads, e.g. restart, data, potential or molecule template files. These are treated exactly like the .xyz file above.

tool.help:
**LAMMPS (Frontier)**
This is a Galaxy tool to run LAMMPS on Frontier.
**Input files**
The ``.lmp`` file is the LAMMPS input script.
All other input files are placed in the directory LAMMPS runs in, using the file name shown in your NDIP history::
read_data system.data read_restart equil.restart pair_coeff * * ff.params
**Output**
Whatever LAMMPS writes in its run directory is collected into the output collection, and the console output is captured separately.
